summary: Public profile buttons and social icons now link straight to the stored URL (href=$link->link) instead of going through the /going/{id}?url redirect; clicks are counted by a JS fetch to /going/{id} on mousedown/touchstart, only when the clicked element itself has class button-click, and only once per link per browser session (sessionStorage). Because stored links are not scheme-validated, javascript: links now become directly clickable on public pages.

statements.why: saveLink/editLink/importData store link URLs without scheme validation (UserController.php:241-278, 711-715, 1157; no exturl/url rule anywhere at this commit). Previously such links went through redirect()->away() (UserController.php:551), so a javascript: URL was inert; now buttons.blade.php/icons.blade.php put it straight in href, so any registered user can plant a script link on their public page that runs on your domain when clicked (stored XSS). Click counts also become less accurate.
Direct hrefs + new JS click counter; card doesn't explain.
Social icons now link directly; counted via JS.

misses.what: Links on public pages now point straight at whatever URL the user saved; since saved links aren't checked, a user can add a 'javascript:' link that runs code in visitors' (including admins') browsers on your site. Before, the redirect page made such links harmless.

Click statistics change: clicks are only counted with JavaScript on, only once per link per visitor session, and not when the visitor clicks the button's icon image (the click lands on the , which lacks the button-click class), so counts will drop compared with before.
Buttons with custom CSS lost their base 'button' class (class changed from 'button button-hover' to 'button-click button-hover'), so their look may change on public pages.
Visitors now go directly to the destination (no /going/ redirect, no X-Robots-Tag noindex header on the hop); destination sites see your page as referrer subject to rel=noreferrer.
